fixed.explanation: The three guards in _AsOfMerge._validate_tolerance reject only negative tolerances, so 0 is valid, but the message said "must be positive". The edits change all three messages to "tolerance must be non-negative". Existing tests that match the old message need the same update, but they were not shown.

query.intent: Validation of the tolerance argument in merge_asof's _AsOfMerge (_validate_tolerance / _get_merge_keys) raises MergeError("tolerance must be positive") when tolerance is negative; zero is accepted. The message should be changed to say "non-negative".
query.symptom: merge_asof raises MergeError "tolerance must be positive" for negative tolerance even though tolerance=0 is accepted, so the message is inconsistent with the guard.

history.analysis: _AsOfMerge._validate_tolerance in pandas/core/reshape/merge.py contains the three guards that raise "tolerance must be positive" while only rejecting negative values. Changing the messages to "tolerance must be non-negative" fixes the issue. The existing tests (test_valid_tolerance, test_tolerance_negative_one_nanosecond) match the old message and will need updating too.
